LanguageData.Lumen_Seed_LetterText: {PAWN_labelShort} has a stake of dreadstone buried in {PAWN_possessive} chest. It will keep {PAWN_objective} alive while it grows through {PAWN_objective}. Nothing will stop the pain.
LanguageData.Lumen_Seed_CutText: The dreadstone seed tore through {PAWN_labelShort}'s {PART}. It will keep cutting as it grows. Tend the wounds or {PAWN_objective} will bleed out before it finishes.
LanguageData.Lumen_Seed_ConsumedText: The dreadstone has taken everything it can from {0}. All that remains is {1} Dark Stone.
